summary: The change adds an independent review at docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-1.md with the verdict "accept with changes". It decides all seven open questions and checks the design's (read) claims against the source. I spot-checked the main citations by reading the files and running grep, and they hold. The lock functions are at state.rs 67-82. The call sites are run.rs 111/116-117/698/1165/1178/1181/1424, manage.rs 80/113/370 and commits.rs 138. plan's stale and replay logic is at land.rs 35-80, the fingerprint scope at attrs.rs 135-139, and the Athena fields at lib.rs 64-77. AgentDriver at agent lib.rs 139 has no Send/Sync bound, while Capability and Pinner do. The review's main finding (F1) is correct and important. plan replays only over records-only changes, so any governed change from a sibling job makes the next job stale, even when the files are disjoint. The review handles today's evidence (the CHANGELOG/D81 collision and the refused hand-merged squash) with concrete rules for shared files and a test. The design's status line, the section 10 intro and item 1 were updated, and a response section was added. Only docs/ changed. One minor inconsistency: the design's response lists F1, F2, F3 and F7 as changes for a later design job, but leaves out the one-sentence fixes for F4, F5 and F6 that the review's table puts in the design.
